content_sections.heading: FRI Dehradun Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download FRI Dehradun Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Junior Project Fellow and 2 for Project Assistant.

content_sections.heading: FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Project Fellow: First class M.Sc. in Forestry/Agroforestry/Botany/Environmental Science. Preference should be given to a candidate having experience in the relevant field. Project Assistant: B.Sc. in Forestry/Botany/Environmental Science. Preference should be given to a candidate having experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Junior Project Fellow: Maximum age limit is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable: 5 years for SC/ST, Women, Physically Handicapped, and OBC candidates. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Project Fellow: Rs. 24,000/- per month (Consolidated) Project Assistant: Rs. 22,000/- per month (Consolidated)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for FRI Dehradun Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10 September 2026. Candidates should reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Project Fellow and Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by FRI Dehradun for the posts of Junior Project Fellow and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Junior Project Fellow?
faq.answer: For the Junior Project Fellow position, candidates must have a First Class M.Sc. degree in Forestry, Agroforestry, Botany, or Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant role, candidates need to possess a B.Sc. degree in Forestry, Botany, or Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Project Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxations are provided for SC/ST, Women, Physically Handicapped, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Junior Project Fellow and Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Project Fellow will receive Rs. 24,000/- per month, and the Project Assistant will receive Rs. 22,000/- per month, both on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for FRI Dehradun Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Forest Research Institute, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, Pin Code: 248006.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data, a recent passport-size photograph, and self-attested copies of all educational certificates and relevant documents.
